She stays fully upright and facing right, with NO rotation, spin, flip or tilt of her body -- only the limbs move. Clearly airborne, no ground or floor anywhere in the image. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped.
